title: Obsolete Create Product Information with Copilot
summary: The Create Product Information with Copilot app is discontinued and its functionality is obsoleted. The upgrade codeunit unregisters the Copilot capability once per database, a notification directs users to modern search instead, and most objects are wrapped in obsolescence guards with Pending state for 30.0 and Removed state for 33.0.
key_points: Copilot capability for item substitution suggestions is unregistered via upgrade codeunit, guarded by upgrade tag MS-659006-UnregisterCreateProductInfoCapability-20261112
Subscriber to OnRegisterCopilotCapability removed to prevent re-registration when capabilities page is opened
New notification in Item Substitution Entry page directs users to use modern search instead, with don't show again option
Most app objects (codeunits, pages, table extension, enums) marked obsolete with Pending state for version 30.0, transitioning to Removed in 33.0
App removed from build configuration so it no longer installs on new environments
quote: Copilot item substitution suggestions are no longer available. Select Use modern search in Search on the Items list to find alternative substitutions.
